description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'FieldInstance' for migrating field instance data from the database. It includes methods for querying, preparing, and processing field instance data, with specific logic for handling translatable fields, taxonomy vocabularies, and user roles.

classes.name: Drupal\field\Plugin\migrate\source\d7\FieldInstance
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for migrating field instance data from the database, with methods for querying, processing, and handling translatable fields, vocabularies, and user roles.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query for retrieving field instance data, with optional filters for entity type and bundle, excluding title module fields.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Executes the query, groups results by field_id, and returns an iterator over the processed rows with all instances grouped.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the data set.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row by unserializing data, fetching field definitions, and determining translatability, vocabulary, and user roles based on field type.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifiers for each row: entity_type, bundle, and field_name.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Returns the count of rows by initializing the iterator and counting its elements.
